claims.content: To maintain accurate and up-to-date master records of Voucher Service Providers (VSPs), including their details, payment terms, staff information, and activation status, to ensure proper claim processing and provider management within the VMUS.

goal.raw_text: To maintain accurate and up-to-date master records of Voucher Service Providers (VSPs), including their details, payment terms, staff information, and activation status, to ensure proper claim processing and provider management within the VMUS.

claims.content: The VMU User needs to add, modify, or delete information related to a Voucher Service Provider (VSP), such as their master details, payment terms, or staff information.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User needs to add, modify, or delete information related to a Voucher Service Provider (VSP), such as their master details, payment terms, or staff information.

claims.content: If the user tries to create a new VSP with an existing name, the system generates a message with two options: 'Continue – Yes/No'. If the user presses 'Yes', the system allows the entry; if not, it prevents saving.

During VSP creation, if any geographical details (District, Sub-District, County, etc.) are not available in the master list, the system provides a provision to navigate quickly to the master screen to enter the details and then return to the VSP screen.

If any staff type is not available in the system during staff creation, the system provides a provision to navigate quickly to the staff type master to enter the new staff type and then return to the Staff Master screen.

If the user attempts to create a new VSP with an existing name and selects 'No' when prompted by the system message ('Continue – Yes/No'), the system will not allow the new entry to be saved, terminating the creation process.
During VSP creation or modification, if mandatory fields (other than Contact No and E-Mail ID) are left blank, the system will prevent saving the record until all required information is provided.

If the system detects more than two fraud entries during the claim process for a particular VSP, it will automatically change the status of that VSP to 'In-activate', preventing further transactions until reactivated by MSIU Management decision.
When creating new staff under a VSP, if any mandatory information (other than Qualification) is missing, the system will not allow the creation of the new staff record.
